# Sam's Pet Services

> Dog walking, pet visits, overnight pet and house sitting, and smallholding, livestock and horse care, and Wedding Day Pet Chaperone service in Brackley, Northamptonshire (NN13) and nearby villages. Run by Sam Rockell. Contact by WhatsApp or phone on 07708 431901, or email samrockell@googlemail.com. Weekends and bank holidays on some dates; ask. Most clients book through Facebook Messenger or WhatsApp. 18 Facebook reviews, 100% recommend.

## Prices (September 2026, GBP, include the first three miles of travel)

- Group walk: 1 hour £14 weekday / £20 weekend and bank holiday; 30 minutes £11 / £15. Dog collected and returned.
- One-to-one walk: 1 hour £19 / £27; 30 minutes £13 / £19.
- Pet visit, 30 minutes (feed, water, play, let out, clean out): £11 weekday / £15 weekend and bank holiday.
- Overnight cat care: £35 a night.
- Overnight dog care: from £50 a night, includes 1 hour of walking, plus £5 for each additional pet.
- Sheep, lambing help, goats, pigs, poultry and horses: price available on request.
- Wedding Day Pet Chaperone (your dog at your wedding, cared for behind the scenes; can be paired with an overnight stay at your home): price available on request.

## Areas

Brackley, Evenley, Turweston, Whitfield, Westbury, Hinton-in-the-Hedges, Mixbury, Croughton, Syresham, Farthinghoe. Mileage charged beyond three miles.
